picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5M NIA grant extends MassAITC for five more years, cementing one of the largest sustained federal investments in AI for aging and Alzheimer's care and deepening the academic-hospital pipeline between UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: A four-university team (MIT, CMU, NYU, Stanford) built an AI that beat top-ranked humans at Stratego, a landmark for imperfect-information game AI that pushes techniques relevant to negotiation, security, and strategic decision-making under uncertainty.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL, Google, and Northeastern's 'InstructMesh' closes a key gap between generative 3D design and real-world manufacturing by letting users fix AI-generated models so they actually function once fabricated.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: An AI-enabled biochip from AUC offers rapid, low-cost disease pre-screening for conditions like leukemia and hepatitis, a potentially high-impact diagnostic tool for resource-limited settings.
picks.title: AI-enabled biochip for rapid cancer, disease detection | The American University in Cairo

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's machine-learning tool estimates past radiation exposure from a routine blood test, offering a faster, more accessible alternative to specialized diagnostics with clear applications in medicine and nuclear emergency response.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern's AI model helps pathologists catch precancerous colon lesions invisible to the naked eye, a concrete step toward AI-augmented cancer screening with direct clinical impact.
picks.title: AI is helping pathologists find harmful lesions the eye can’t see

picks.editorial_note: Harvard's Belfer Center 'pre-mortem' report on catastrophic AI risk, citing rogue-agent breaches and a major lab's training pause, adds weight to the policy debate over how urgently governments must act on frontier AI safety.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: An $8.1M package of Australian Research Council grants to ANU builds a sustainable materials-science workforce and critical-resource exploration capacity, a notable national investment tied to AI-driven materials research.
picks.title: ANU receives $8.1 million to unlock new materials, critical resources

picks.editorial_note: A new CRADA between Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory pairs space-based AI-inference computing with weather-modeling expertise, a strategic industry-government-academia partnership with implications for space-based forecasting infrastructure.
picks.title: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory announce research collaboration on space-based weather modeling

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's $8M in federal Strengthening Institutions Program grants funds AI education and workforce-alignment initiatives, expanding access to AI training at a public research university.
picks.title: UCR receives $8 million in federal grants
